assemblerItemCapsNote: HARD per-component item caps enforced by the assembler (_cap_tab_items in assembly/core.py). Deliberately INDEPENDENT of densityGates above: densityGates is advisory steering text shown to the planner LLM (what to aim for), these caps are the code backstop (what ships regardless of prompt drift) — e.g. step_player is steered to 10 but capped at 25. moment_track's cap additionally scales with video duration in code (evenly sampled, clamped 20-60).
domainRequirementsNote: Per-domain assembled-output validation (_validate_domain_requirements in assembly/core.py): `required` components are backfilled from defaultTabs when the planner drops them (promotion equivalents count, e.g. comparison_radar satisfies comparison); `max` caps per-component tab counts. Every domain must have an entry — an empty `required` is a deliberate decision (music: lyrics_karaoke optional so videos without per-line timing don't fail; podcast: moment_track segments are the spine; news: claims_tracker is the signature accountability surface; gaming: tier_list; sport: formation_diagram).
